formulas.motor_power: Motor mechanical power in kW = torque in N m x RPM / 9549. Use values from the same instant; battery electrical power is a different quantity.
formulas.motor_torque: Torque in N m = 9549 x power in kW / RPM.
formulas.horsepower: Horsepower = kW x 1.341 (1 hp = 0.746 kW); from torque: hp = torque in N m x RPM / 7120.
formulas.battery_capacity: Energy in Wh = capacity in Ah x nominal pack voltage in V; mAh / 1000 = Ah; kWh = Wh / 1000. The nominal voltage is needed for the conversion; mAh alone is not an energy rating.
formulas.wh_per_km: Energy consumption in Wh/km = energy used in Wh / distance in km; kWh per 100 km = Wh/km / 10. Lower is more efficient.
formulas.range_estimate: Estimated range = state of charge x usable capacity / recent consumption (Wh/km). It is an estimate: speed, weather, climate use and load change it.
formulas.tyre_pressure: 1 psi = 6.895 kPa; 1 bar = 100 kPa = 14.5 psi. Read tyre pressures when the tyres are cold.
formulas.distance_driven: 1 mile = 1.609 km, so miles = km / 1.609; the distance driven is the integral of speed over time.
formulas.charge_time: Charging time = energy needed in kWh / average charging power in kW; power tapers near full, so the last 10-20% takes longer.
formulas.charge_cost: Cost = energy drawn from the wall in kWh x your electricity price per kWh; wall energy is about battery energy / 0.9.
formulas.battery_soc: State of charge is estimated by the battery management system from voltage, current integration and calibration; it is not measured directly.
formulas.battery_soh: State of health = present usable capacity / original capacity x 100.
formulas.energy_used: Energy in kWh = power in kW x time in hours; the engine integrates battery power over the period (discharge only for energy used).
formulas.regen_energy: Regenerated energy is the integral of negative battery power while the car is moving.
formulas.acceleration: Acceleration = change in speed / time; 1 km/h per second = 0.278 m/s squared.
formulas.speed: Speed in km/h = RPM x wheel circumference in m x 60 / (1000 x overall gear ratio).
formulas.diagnostic_code: A diagnostic trouble code is read from the ECU through the diagnostic port or from the recorded events; its first letter names the system (P powertrain, C chassis, B body, U network).
formulas.service_reminder: A service reminder is cleared by the workshop after the service; this assistant is read-only and cannot reset it.
formulas.driving_style: The driving score starts at 100 and loses 2.5 points for each hard brake per 100 km above 3, 2.5 for each hard acceleration per 100 km above 2, 3 for each hard corner per 100 km above 1, and 0.3 for each percent of moving time above 110 km/h over 10 percent. It is a simple measure of smoothness built from recorded events, not an industry standard.
formulas.turn_radius: Turning radius is derived directly when possible: R = wheelbase / tan(steering angle); otherwise R = speed / yaw rate; otherwise R = speed squared / lateral acceleration (speed in m/s).
formulas.wheel_slip: Wheel slip = (mean wheel speed - vehicle speed) / vehicle speed. Positive slip means the wheels spin faster than the car moves.
formulas.thermal_rise_rate: Thermal rise rate = change of battery temperature divided by time, in degrees Celsius per minute.
formulas.battery_efficiency: Battery-to-wheel efficiency = motor mechanical power / battery electrical power.
